tools.name: prepare_cadon_context
tools.description:
Check whether CADON has enough safe pre-context before rendering provider cards.

    Call this before any CADON offer-card tool. CADON returns the missing safe context
    the assistant should ask in natural language. It does not request personal data,
    income, address, email, phone, account numbers, KYC, documents, or regulated form
    data. If ready_for_cards is false, ask the returned question and do not show cards.
    If ready_for_cards is true, call next_tool with next_tool_args.

    Only pass safe context the user stated in the CURRENT conversation. Do not fill
    query, vehicle_type, budget_eur, or safe_context from assistant memory or previous
    chats; if remembered preferences exist, ask the user to confirm them in chat first.

    Enforcement: required context that does not appear in the query text itself (i.e.
    was supplied only via vehicle_type/budget_eur/model_hint/safe_context) returns
    ready_for_cards=false with confirmation_required=true and a recap question. Ask
    that question in chat; only after the user explicitly confirms, call this tool
    again with the same arguments plus user_confirmed=true. Never set user_confirmed
    to true unless the user just confirmed the recap in this conversation.

    Args:
        query: The user's request plus their exact answers from this conversation.
        market: Two-letter market/country where the user wants providers ranked.
        scenario: Optional known CADON scenario/taxonomy key. Leave blank to detect.
        vehicle_type: Optional explicit car-loan context: "new" or "used".
        budget_eur: Optional explicit approximate amount/budget in EUR.
        model_hint: Optional non-sensitive car model/dealer/photo context.
        safe_context: Optional extra safe context as text or a small JSON object string.
        preferred_provider: Optional current/preferred bank or financial provider name.
        user_confirmed: Set true ONLY after the user confirmed the recap question.

tools.name: get_cadon_conversation_guide
tools.description:
Return CADON's real-life conversation guidance for a journey. Read-only.

    The guidance covers tone, safety-first ordering (e.g. block a lost card before
    any product talk), the safe questions to ask, hard prohibitions, and non-partner
    handling. prepare_cadon_context already returns the same guidance as
    conversation_guidance; call this tool when you want the fuller block with
    examples, or pass an empty scenario to read the entire playbook.

    Args:
        scenario: A CADON scenario key, taxonomy key (cj_*), a cross-cutting topic
            ("resume", "pii_in_chat", "impatient_user", "privacy_question",
            "scam_safe_account", "declined_outcome", "debt_stress",
            "acting_for_someone_else", "minor_user", "financial_literacy"), or the
            user's own words (e.g. "I lost my card"). Empty returns the full playbook.

tools.name: show_car_loan_bank_options
tools.description:
Show graphical clickable bank cards for the fictional CADON car-loan demo.

    Use this only after prepare_cadon_context returns ready_for_cards=true for car_loan,
    passing the returned preflight_token.
    The required safe context is new/used car, approximate budget, and optional
    model/dealer-offer/photo hint. A preferred loan duration/term in months is optional.
    It returns ranked provider cards
    with clickable demo links, filters, and pagination. Do not ask the user for income,
    employment, debts, address, phone, email, documents, KYC, or affordability details
    in chat. If the user types a bank name or number instead of clicking, call this same
    tool again with choice set to that reply.
     After this tool returns and the widget renders, end your turn with a completely empty response: zero characters, no caption, no 'displayed above', no invitation to pick.

tools.name: show_cadon_demo_offers
tools.description:
Render fictional partner-bank offer cards for a CADON demo scenario.

    Use this only after prepare_cadon_context returns ready_for_cards=true, passing the
    returned preflight_token, except when the user is selecting a bank from cards already shown.
    This can be called with any supported scenario key or a natural-language customer
    journey from the retail/private-banking taxonomy. It is presentation-only mock data
    and does not start or submit a real application. Do not ask the user for personal,
    KYC, contact, income, account, document, or other regulated form fields in chat.
    Use safe_context only for non-sensitive preference context. If the user types a
    bank/provider name or number instead of clicking, call this same tool again with
    choice set to that reply.
     After this tool returns and the widget renders, end your turn with a completely empty response: zero characters, no caption, no 'displayed above', no invitation to pick.

tools.name: resume_cadon_session
tools.description:
Render a resume button for a previously saved CADON session.

    Use this when the user says they want to resume, list, show, find, or continue
    a previous CADON session. If the user describes the saved session by context
    ("the stolen card one", "the investment one", "with Meridian", a reference
    number, etc.), pass that wording in query. Do not start a fresh provider-card
    search from a resume request.

    It returns only a zero-PII session reference to the chat UI; the secure token
    is fetched by the widget from CADON when the user clicks Resume session.
     After this tool returns and the widget renders, end your turn with a completely empty response: zero characters, no caption, no 'displayed above', no invitation to pick.

tools.name: get_car_loan_demo_link
tools.description:
Get a read-only browser launch URL for the fictional CADON car-loan demo.

    Use this only when the user explicitly asks to skip bank comparison or directly open
    a bank. For the normal car-loan request, use show_car_loan_bank_options first. Do
    not ask for vehicle price, down payment, loan duration, income, employment, debts,
    KYC, or affordability details in chat. The browser demo handles the simulated flow
    after the user clicks the returned URL.

    Args:
        preferred_bank: Optional fictional bank id. Defaults to "aureus".
        market: Two-letter demo market/country. Defaults to "BE".

annotations.title: Get car loan demo launch link

tools.name: get_cadon_demo_link
tools.description:
Build a read-only launch URL for a browser-based CADON demo using fictional data.

    This tool does not create a session or call a bank. The mock session is created only
    after the user clicks the returned URL in their browser. It cannot start or submit a
    real application, open an account, move money, or make a credit decision. Do not ask
    the user for vehicle price, down payment, income, employment, debt, or other form
    fields in chat; the demo flow belongs behind the returned URL.

    Args:
        scenario: A fictional demo scenario key returned by list_cadon_demo_scenarios.
        preferred_bank: Optional fictional bank id chosen from show_cadon_demo_offers.
        market: Two-letter market/country (e.g. "FR", "BE"). Default "EU".

tools.name: get_demo_result
tools.description:
Read the fictional outcome produced by the CADON simulation. Read-only.

    This result is generated by a deterministic mock and is not an eligibility, lending,
    suitability, or account decision. It contains no personal or financial data. Prefer
    launch_id when the session was opened through get_cadon_demo_link.
